children: The founder of Japan's Terra Drone says that defense contractors' reliance on Taiwanese components leaves drone supply chains exposed to geopolitical conflict. While Taiwanese parts offer a cost-effective alternative to expensive Western components, Toru Tokushige noted that a potential naval blockade of Taiwan would instantly halt critical supplies. "If Taiwan gets encircled by fleets, no supplies will be able to get through," he said in a recent interview with The Wall Street Journal. Terra Drone's government contract win contributed to a surge in its share price, which last closed 0.9% higher at 20,280 yen. (megumi.fujikawa@wsj.com)
